chapter: Learning, lawn parties and band rivalries
title: Musicians and barbershops
summary: Dawson says few musicians cut hair, apart from Papa John, and that musicians did not hang around barbershops.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: I haven't seen, uh. How we doing on time? We got plenty? Yeah, I got more tape left. Yeah. What about the barbershops? Did many musicians work in the barbershops?
Not as I know, no, not that. Not many of them cut hair? No, the only one I know had a barber shop was Papa John.
Yeah. Thanks for that. They had a barber shop uptown. Yeah, what about Paul Dominguez? Do you remember Paul Dominguez?
I heard of him. He had one on Claiborne between Columbus and Calarac. Yeah, yeah, well I heard of him. I didn't know much about it.
Were there some barber shops around the Big 25 or Elk Place or something? Yeah, but I didn't know none of them.
